links.outcome: Harmful chatbot responses to simulated users in suicidal crisis at ideation and planning stages
links.effect: Three-tier harm structure: companion apps and Grok 4.3 high-harm; Gemini 3.1 Pro mid-range; GPT-5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5 lower harm. At planning, companion apps show more glorification, advancement toward harmful action, and harmful methods.
links.quote: At planning, companion apps show increased glorification and normalisation, advancement toward harmful action, and harmful methods and instructions.

links.outcome: Chatbot safety of responses in multi-turn crisis conversations despite crisis recognition
links.effect: Crisis recognition and empathetic language did not ensure safe responses; harm varied across platforms in 20-turn conversations.
links.quote: Crisis recognition and empathetic language do not ensure safe responses.

unlisted_practices: Product-level (deployed app) safety evaluation across crisis stages rather than base-model evaluation only

screen.reason: Evaluates safety risks and intervention behaviors of deployed AI companion chatbots and LLMs across multi-turn simulated suicidal crisis interactions.
